info.title: API.SH: Chess
info.description: The Chess API from API.SH: public Chess data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.summary: Chess club or team profile and members
get.description:
A chess.com club (name, country, average daily rating, member count, admins, description, created and last activity) with its members grouped by activity (this week, this month, all time) and when each joined; or a lichess.org team (name, description, leaders, member count).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/chess-club

parameters.name: club
parameters.description: Club url-id (chess.com/club/<id>) or lichess team id, or the club/team link.

parameters.name: site
parameters.description: chesscom (default) or lichess; a pasted link picks the site.

parameters.name: members
parameters.description: false skips the member list (chess.com).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A player's games, newest first: players and ratings, result and termination, time control and class, rated, opening and ECO, accuracies (chess.com), rating change, accuracy and mistake counts when analysed, game phases and source (lichess), final position and full PGN. chess.com: one month at a time (default the latest; `months` lists every month with games), or a date range with `from`/`to` (up to 3 months read per call; pass `next_to` back as `to` for older games, null when done). lichess: the latest games; pass `next_until` back as `until` for older ones (with `sort=oldest`, pass `next_after` back as `after`). Filters: `time_class`, `color`, `result`, `opponent`, `rated`, `opening`, `eco`, `from`/`since` and `to` work on both sites; `analysed`, `ongoing` and `clocks` on lichess. `opening`, `eco` and `result` are applied to the games read, so a page can hold fewer than `limit` games. When a filter is given the answer also has `applied_filters`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/chess-games

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: Username.

parameters.name: site
parameters.description: chesscom or lichess.

parameters.name: month
parameters.description: YYYY-MM: games of that month.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Games to return (chess.com 1-500, lichess 1-100; default 50).

parameters.name: perf
parameters.description: lichess only: bullet, blitz, rapid, classical, correspondence, chess960 ...

parameters.name: rated
parameters.description: lichess only: true rated games only, false casual only.

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: lichess only: `next_until` from the previous page.

parameters.name: time_class
parameters.description: Only games of this time class: bullet, blitz, rapid, daily (lichess: correspondence) or classical (lichess). On lichess it stands in for `perf` when `perf` is not given.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Only games the player had this colour in.

parameters.name: result
parameters.description: Only games the player won, lost or drew. On lichess it is applied to the page of games fetched, so a page can hold fewer than `limit` games; keep paging with `next_until`.

parameters.name: opponent
parameters.description: Only games against this username.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Games played from this date (YYYY-MM-DD or epoch milliseconds). Same as `from`.

parameters.name: analysed
parameters.description: lichess only: true for games with computer analysis, false for games without.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Games played from this date (YYYY-MM-DD or epoch milliseconds).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Games played up to this date, inclusive (YYYY-MM-DD or epoch milliseconds). chess.com pages with `next_to`.

parameters.name: opening
parameters.description: Only games whose opening name contains this text (e.g. sicilian defense, queens gambit declined).

parameters.name: eco
parameters.description: Only games whose ECO code starts with this (e.g. B90, B9 or B).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: lichess only: newest first (default) or oldest first (page with `next_after` as `after`).

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: lichess only, with sort=oldest: `next_after` from the previous page.

parameters.name: ongoing
parameters.description: lichess only: true also returns games still being played.

parameters.name: clocks
parameters.description: lichess only: true adds the clock after every move (`clocks_centiseconds`).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Chess.com or lichess player profile and ratings
get.description:
A player's public profile and ratings: chess.com (name, title, country, location, followers, joined, last online, streamer, league; current, best and record of every rating: rapid, blitz, bullet, daily, daily 960; FIDE, tactics and puzzle rush) or lichess (title, patron, bio, country, FIDE/USCF rating, created, last seen, play time, game counts; rating, deviation, games and progress in every variant).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/chess-player

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: Username.

parameters.name: site

get.description:
A chess.com tournament: settings (type, time control, rating range, rounds, group size), status, dates, every registered player and their status; with `round` the round's advancing players and each group's standings and games. A lichess arena: settings, podium, stats and the standings page by page (pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/chess-tournament

parameters.name: tournament
parameters.description: Tournament url-id or link (chess.com/tournament/<id>, lichess.org/tournament/<id>).

parameters.name: site
parameters.description: chesscom (default) or lichess; a pasted link picks the site.

parameters.name: round
parameters.description: chess.com: also return this round's groups, standings and games.

parameters.name: groups
parameters.description: chess.com: how many groups of the round to include (0-20, default 5).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: lichess: standings page (10 players each).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
